ns2:course.label: Foundations of Advertising
ns2:course.description: Explores the development of American advertising through the 20th and into the early 21st century. Analyzes and evaluates American advertising through these primary areas: ethics, advertising philosophies, advertising structure, advertising education, its broader social impact, the role of media and technologies, and its place within a global framework. Prerequisite: Consent of department.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Communications or Communications and Media major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
